item.title: [−3] US-Iran war latest news: Trump signals Pickaxe Mountain strike, rules out nuclear weapons; 2 tanker carrying 24 Indian sailors hit in Strait of Hormuz
item.description:
Signal: shipping chokepoint disruption. 45 reports from The Times of India, Newsquawk, The Economic Times and 33 more. Related: “EXCLUSIVE: Iran ships some LPG, jet fuel despite US blockade, data shows”. Ongoing: also reported on 6 of the previous 7 days (first 10 Oct).

Aviation, shipping & logistics: strong headwind (−3) — Freight, insurance and fuel costs rise

Why it matters: India imports most of its crude and much of its LNG through Hormuz and the Red Sea; disruption lifts oil, freight and insurance costs, widening the import bill and pressuring the rupee.

Market gauges: Fiscal & trade balance −3, Inflation outlook −1, Rupee −1, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) −1

Confidence: high · horizon: weeks

item.title: [−3] OPEC holds high-level energy dialogues with China and India, focusing on oil market stability and long-term investment
item.description:
Signal: higher oil prices. 10 reports from Energies Media, The National, INDIA New England News and 6 more. Related: “US stocks: US market ends down sharply; worries about AI trade and high oil prices weigh”. Ongoing: also reported on 2 of the previous 7 days (first 13 Oct).

Aviation, shipping & logistics: strong headwind (−3) — Jet fuel is airlines' biggest cost

Why it matters: India imports over 80% of its crude, so dearer oil widens the trade deficit, weakens the rupee, feeds inflation and squeezes fuel marketers, airlines and companies using crude-based inputs.

Market gauges: Fiscal & trade balance −3, Inflation outlook −1, Rupee −1, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) −1

Confidence: high · horizon: weeks

item.title: [+1] RBI's rupee boost to spur rally, trigger swings in forward premiums
item.description:
Signal: a stronger rupee. 38 reports from The Hindu, BusinessLine, Bloomberg.com and 24 more. Related: “Rupee to extend recovery, RBI takes more steps to ease pressure”. Ongoing: also reported on 3 of the previous 7 days (first 11 Oct).

Aviation, shipping & logistics: mild tailwind (+1) — Dollar costs ease

Why it matters: A stronger rupee lowers import costs and inflation but trims IT and pharma exporters' rupee earnings.

Market gauges: Rupee +3, Inflation outlook +1, Foreign investor flows +1

Confidence: high · horizon: weeks
